This recipe is meant to show you how to make the peanut butter sandwich to end all others.

==Ingredients==
* 2 slices of [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]], soft
* [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|Peanut butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Honey|Honey]]
* Preserves ([[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]) 
* Very cold [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Toasting|Toast]] and butter the bread slices.
# Combine the peanut butter, honey, and butter. Spread over one slice of toasted bread.
# Spread preserves (jam) over the other slice.
# Put both halves of sandwich together.
# Cut in half and serve with milk

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Beware! The peanut butter mixture is sloppy. If the peanut butter is too sloppy, try spreading the honey thin on both slices of bread and omit the extra butter.
* [[Cookbook:Raisin|Raisins]] may be added. They have a honey-like flavor, which will compliment the honey in the sandwich.
* [[Cookbook:Banana|Bananas]] are traditional side items. They go well with peanut butter.
* These directions can be varied according to preference.
* Try with pickled [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]]. Sounds odd but don't dismiss until you've tried it.
